messages:
IncidentBot: 🚨 ALERT: spike observed — api-gateway returning 502/504 across edge clusters (us-west-1, eu-west-1). 5xx rate jumped from 0.3% -> 6% in last 2m. auto-pager triggered for SRE.
Maya Patel: paging oncall (Raj) — taking it. I see errors across both regions.
Rajesh Kumar: saw the alert, on it. checking gateway dashboards + edge-proxy logs.
Kelly Chen: I'm seeing increased backend latency to model-service from gateway (p95 -> 3.2s). could be upstream saturation.
Sam Ortiz: also noticing a large fanout for a new client path /v1/stream that started around 00:05 UTC. might be correlated.
Carla Nguyen: customer impact: partial — some webhooks and chat flows getting 502s, embedded jobs mostly ok. we have a spike in error-rate for realtime calls.
Rajesh Kumar: running quick curl against healthy edge node: `curl -I https://edge-us-west1.redwood/api/health` -> HTTP/1.1 200 OK from edge. but proxy -> upstream shows `upstream prematurely closed connection` in logs.
Kelly Chen: pasted sample from nginx error log: ```[error] 12345#0: *67890 recv() failed (104: Connection reset by peer) while reading response header from upstream, client: 10.0.0.1, server: gateway```
Sam Ortiz: that suggests upstream (model-service or routing mesh) closing connections. I'll open k8s dashboards and check pod restarts.
DeployBot: Deploy notice: rolling deploy of model-router v2.14 started 00:03 UTC, canary to 10% (commit abcdef1).
Maya Patel: @Raj — can you check if deploy correlates with spike? if so, pause rollout / revert.
Rajesh Kumar: confirmed timing aligns with canary start. scaling for model-router pods shows new pods flapping (CrashLoopBackOff) in logs around 00:04-00:06.
Carla Nguyen: customer-facing note: minor degradation for chat sessions started after 00:05 UTC. CS notified for high-touch customers.
Kelly Chen: looking at RT metrics: connection resets at upstream target ip 10.12.8.33, kernel logs show `OOM killer invoked` on that node.
Sam Ortiz: scaling group for model-hosts in us-west-1 shows CPU spike and some OOMs; memory footprint increased post-deploy.
Rajesh Kumar: action plan: 1) pause model-router rollout, 2) rollback canary commit abcdef1 -> abcdef0, 3) temporarily enable circuit-breaker to reduce fanout on /v1/stream (limit concurrency), 4) route traffic off problematic nodes (drain).
Maya Patel: I'm taking rollback. @DeployBot, initiate rollback to abcdef0 for model-router in both regions.
DeployBot: Rolling back model-router to commit abcdef0 in canary and standard pools. ETA ~2m. Will post status.
IncidentBot: PagerDuty: SRE oncall notified (Rajesh Kumar). Priority: P1.
PagerDuty: Pager duty: ACK for SRE-ELB group. On-call: Rajesh Kumar.
Rajesh Kumar: draining node 10.12.8.33 from LB; cordon+evict in progress.
Kelly Chen: enabling temporary 502 circuit-breaker on gateway routing rules for path /v1/stream (limit concurrency 50 -> 10). config patch: ```- route: /v1/stream
  circuit_breaker:
    max_conns: 10
    max_retries: 2
```
Sam Ortiz: applying config now to edge clusters.
Maya Patel: updating status: rolling rollback started; draining one OOM node; circuit-breaker applied; CS updated to queued customers.
DeployBot: Rollback finished on canary; monitoring for error-rate.
Rajesh Kumar: post-rollback: immediate drop in 5xx from 6% -> 1.2% within 30s in us-west; eu-west still elevated (approx 2.5%).
Kelly Chen: eu-west appears to have one straggler node with high memory growth; evicting and replacing it.
Carla Nguyen: tally of customer impact: ~2% of requests affected, with highest impact on streaming chat. No billing incidents. Logging tickets OPEN-1122 for affected pay customers.
Maya Patel: can we put an automated fallback to a lighter-weight model-router variant for streaming requests until patch?
Sam Ortiz: yes, we have v2-lite quantized variant ready. we can route 20% of stream traffic to v2-lite as a fallback. requires routing change.
Rajesh Kumar: agree — do gradual shift 10% -> 20% to avoid spike. initiating route rule now.
Kelly Chen: monitoring p50/p95 and error-rate. setting alert threshold to 1.5% 5xx for next 30m.
IncidentBot: Note: created incident ticket INC-2026-1780012345.
Maya Patel: summary for postmortem: root cause likely regression in model-router memory management introduced in abcdef1 causing OOMs and upstream resets -> gateway 502/504 spike. mitigation: rollback, drain OOM nodes, circuit-breaker, route fallback to v2-lite. next steps: hotfix for memory leak + stricter canary observation.
Carla Nguyen: I'll draft customer update and post to status.redwood.io once we confirm eu-west normalized.
Rajesh Kumar: eu-west error-rate returning to baseline ~0.4% after node replacement.
Maya Patel: thanks team. I'll keep incident open for 2h for follow-up and root cause analysis.
Kelly Chen: leaving a reminder: add canary health check for heap/memory growth and alert on >20% increase in mem usage within 5m.
Sam Ortiz: ops note: created runbook step to throttle heavy fanout endpoints during gateway 5xx spikes.
Carla Nguyen: CS note: outreach scheduled to top 5 impacted customers.
Maya Patel: closing update soon if metrics stable. :white_check_mark:
